name: Color-Sliced-Pattern-A
$description: Not the default: use Color-Sliced-Pattern-B (the same slices with the QDRANT letter layer) in most creatives. Use A, without letters, only in creatives with headshots (Vanesa, 2026-11-11).
$colorways: Amaranth, Indigo and Teal each run from Neutral 975 to the family's 800 (Vanesa, 2026-11-26, Lower contrast #8): a near-black start, so the colour reads as the accent. It replaced the family's 975 → 700 (S6, 2026-11-24). Teal stays on hold. Dark neutral (Neutral 1000 → 800) added 2026-11-24. Every render has an ordered dither against banding (2026-11-26).

colorways.name: Neutral 975 → Teal 800
colorways.onHold: Waiting for the council's approval of the sub-direction (Vanesa, 2026-11-24). Don't use it in creatives yet.

colorways.name: Neutral 100 → Neutral 300
colorways.onHold: Light mode: on hold (Vanesa, 2026-11-26). Don't use it in creatives yet.

settings.$stripes: Approved stripe options besides the preset's own slices (thickness 80, -160°), picked in the Pattern Library review (Vanesa, 2026-11-24). Render one with renderPattern(..., { stripes: index }). Thickness in px at 1080, on the 8 grid. Fixed angle since 2026-11-26 (Vanesa): every stripe runs at -160° (70° from horizontal); the flatter (-152°) and steeper (-168°) options were removed.
